name: cashmere
description: Cross-chain USDC payments and transfers over Cashmere CCTP, and Goat LP liquidity on Robinhood Chain: an MCP server that quotes, lists routes and sends, with skills that run each action with the user's confirmation

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Read tools only: cashmere_bridge and the Goat LP write tools stay off, and the keys below are not read

max_amount.title: Largest transfer (USDC)
max_amount.description: cashmere_bridge refuses transfers above this amount, such as 500. Leave empty for no limit

max_total.title: Largest total (USDC)
max_total.description: cashmere_bridge stops once it has sent this much in one session, such as 2000. Leave empty for no limit

allowed_recipients.title: Allowed recipients
allowed_recipients.description: Comma-separated addresses cashmere_bridge may send to. Leave empty to allow any recipient

goatlp_max_deposit_usd.title: Goat LP: largest deposit (USD)
goatlp_max_deposit_usd.description: goatlp_add_liquidity refuses deposits worth more than this, such as 100. Leave empty for no limit

goatlp_max_total_usd.title: Goat LP: largest total (USD)
goatlp_max_total_usd.description: goatlp_add_liquidity stops once it has deposited this much in one session, such as 500. Leave empty for no limit

robinhood_rpc_url.title: Robinhood Chain RPC
robinhood_rpc_url.description: https RPC for the Goat LP tools. Leave empty for the public endpoint

evm_private_key.title: EVM private key
evm_private_key.description: Hex key of the wallet that sends from EVM chains, as MetaMask exports it. Leave empty to skip

solana_private_key.title: Solana private key
solana_private_key.description: Base58 key (Phantom, Solflare), JSON array or hex of the wallet that sends from Solana. Leave empty to skip

aptos_private_key.title: Aptos private key
aptos_private_key.description: Hex or ed25519-priv-0x... key (Petra) of the wallet that sends from Aptos. Leave empty to skip

sui_private_key.title: Sui private key
sui_private_key.description: suiprivkey1... key (Slush, Sui Wallet) or hex of the wallet that sends from Sui. Leave empty to skip
